commit: 51ed53dbe3c96a81686ae1fc47f6d2a92f668159

This directory is a mechanically rewritten copy of the upstream project.
The ONLY edits are package/module renames (see build/vendor.py) needed so
all three upstream projects -- which each ship a top-level package called
'Scripts' -- can be imported into one process. All behavioural changes are
applied at runtime by opcoreforge/patches.py; nothing here is hand-edited.
